oracle_is_not_proof: The oracle cross-checks observable behaviour. It is not evidence that WebKitGTK is correct, and it never gates the native lane.

tolerances._rationale: The oracle is an external cross-check of observable behaviour, not a second implementation of the runner contract. It evaluates no gates, produces no capability report, and emits no receipts, so those three surfaces are declared tolerable here and nowhere else: they are structurally absent, not behaviourally different. Step identity, method, per-step status and the terminal code are compared strictly — those are what the two lanes must agree on.
